It was unfortunate the time I spent I enjoyed the videos and the options for music as well, as learning progression but the feature that would have set them apart from other options unfortunately did not work as advertised.

reviews.title: Wish it were better
reviews.text:
The videos are spectacular! The instructors are engaging and informative. I’ve learned quite a bit here, as it is superior to most the hit or miss You Tube videos.  Highly recommended.

Now for the three star rating.  The note following app is abysmal. It lags then jumps, the metronome is ticked but the music does not advance, with or without wired headphones as suggested. I can’t get above 82% because of this.  In another app, I’m getting 92-96% and scores feel right to me.

I love the video but won’t waste my time in the practice sessions striving for a medal at 95% or better.  Do the exercises until you feel good about your playing then move on.

Overall, I’m glad I subscribed for the videos but am thankful for the “Tenestro Violin”app to deliver useful feedback.

reviews.text:
Trala is worth every penny you spend on its violin lessons ! I’m finally learning how to play a music instrument as a retired senior ! I wanted real music in my life ! Not processed noise that I hear these days ! Trala has helped me enter another chapter of my life !

July 26 , 2024.   It’s been a year now with Rasa !  I struggle with basics at times. So I went back to these basics videos. They’re very helpful  I should’ve spent more time with them before !   I love the violin and don’t mind going back to the basics to help me make a better music sound !

reviews.title: Great App for adult learners
reviews.text: I recently had my first lesson and the instructor was very helpful and encouraging. It was a wonderful learning experience. The app is user friendly and easy to navigate. I do however have a few suggestions to make it even better. It would be great if the learner had the ability to select a segment of a song/lesson to repeat rather than having to play the entire piece allowing the learner to focus on a difficult segment. It would also be nice if the library of songs, over 500, were listed based on difficulty such as levels 1-4. Or very easy, easy, moderate, advanced/difficult. This would allow the learn the chance to choose alternate pieces to practice newly learned skills.
